'''''Resistance Rewind''''' is a series of behind-the-scenes [[Wikipedia:YouTube|YouTube]] videos produced by [[StarWars.com]] that looks at each ''[[Star Wars Resistance]]'' [[Star Wars Resistance Season One|Season One]] episode.
